purpose: Backup primary-source audit for the 2013 urea ROCK2 assay and a deferred record for the 2017 GRK2 off-target ROCK2 assay.

criteria_applied: no identity or structural overlap with evaluated panels
exact labels separated from censored bounds

primary.version_note: The archived ACS article copy is an accepted/proof version; preserve this version label and do not describe it as the final version of record without independent confirmation.

method_findings.article_and_si: The article reports a Cisbio STK2 HTRF ROCK-I/II biochemical assay. The SI states that ROCK-II 1-543 was cloned and purified as described earlier; other active enzymes were purchased from Upstate.
method_findings.target_construct: Human ROCK-II residues 1-543 are supported by the cited Schröter primary protocol, which describes an N-terminal 6-His/TEV recombinant construct from human brain RNA. This is cited-protocol evidence rather than a 2013 lot-specific sequence certificate.
method_findings.rock_ii_conditions: The article reports a 5 uL mixture containing 1 uM STK2 substrate and 20 uM ATP, followed by 5 uL of 0.5 nM ROCK-II, 4 h at room temperature, HTRF stop/detection reagents, 1 h detection incubation, and ViewLux HTRF reading. Volume arithmetic gives approximately 0.5 uM substrate, 10 uM ATP, and 0.25 nM enzyme in the 10 uL reaction; these are calculated values, not direct final concentrations reported by the article.
method_findings.endpoint: ROCK-II IC50 values; HTRF/TR-FRET biochemical inhibition endpoint, distinct from luciferase or cellular endpoints.

cited_protocol.citation: Schröter et al., Journal of Biomolecular Screening 13 (2008) 17-28
cited_protocol.evidence_status: official indexed primary text supports human 6-His ROCK-II 1-543; PDF retrieval through the storage wrapper returned HTTP 403, so no local hash is asserted

limits: The ChEMBL assay description does not independently specify species or construct, so article-to-assay linkage remains a source-document reconciliation claim.

The model sequence used in earlier work is human ROCK2 residues 11-552, while the cited urea method is ROCK-II 1-543; this construct mismatch must be disclosed and prevents treating the assays as sequence-identical.
Murcko scaffold diversity, especially pendant-ring substitutions, is not equivalent to independent pharmacophore or mechanism diversity.

reconciled_sources.reconciliation_summary: All92ChEMBL records uniquely matched to author structures and values; six canonical-tautomer equivalences recorded explicitly. Author CSV has93rows: source-only30r>10000nM absent fromChEMBL. Primary historical methods remain unverified.

grk2_2017_deferred.what_is_supported: ChEMBL assay metadata describes recombinant human N-terminal GST-tagged ROCK2 catalytic domain residues 1-553, baculovirus expression, STK 2-biotin substrate, and HTRF/TR-FRET measurement after 60 minutes.
grk2_2017_deferred.what_is_not_supported: The accessible primary article/protocol text did not establish the actual historical ATP concentration, reagent concentrations, enzyme lot, or complete assay procedure. ACS article access was blocked by a Cloudflare challenge; the LookChem copy is only an accepted-manuscript preview and omits the assay methods.
grk2_2017_deferred.eligibility_decision: defer; metadata alone is insufficient for the strict primary-method eligibility rule despite strong structure/value reconciliation
grk2_2017_deferred.no_bypass: No access-control bypass, outreach, or inference from another ROCK2/STK2 protocol was used.

overall_decision: 2013urea selected after completed primary graph/value reconciliation and fixedsplit verification. 2017remains deferred. See eligibility-decision.json.
